info.title: API.SH: Solscan
info.description: The Solscan API from API.SH: public Solscan data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A Solana account as Solscan shows it: type, SOL balance and lamports, owner program, executable flag, size, public label and tags, notices, and the token info and metadata when the account is a token mint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-account

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A Solana address or a solscan.io account link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The tokens an account holds, largest value first: token mint, token account, name, symbol, icon, balance, decimals, USD price and value, with the count. `type=nft` lists NFTs instead.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-account-tokens

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A Solana address or a solscan.io account link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The transactions of an account, newest first: signature, slot, time, status, fee, signers, tags, parsed instructions (type, program), SOL value and programs called. Pass `next_before` back as `before` for the next page; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-account-transactions

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A Solana address or a solscan.io account link.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Signature to page from (the `next_before` of the previous page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Token and SOL transfers of an account with the site's filters, newest first: signature, slot, time, activity, from and to (with labels and token accounts), token (mint, name, symbol, icon, price), amount, USD value, flow and programs. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-account-transfers

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A Solana address or a solscan.io account link.

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Comma-separated: transfer, mint, burn, create_account, close_account.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One block (slot): time, block hash and previous hash, parent slot, block height, epoch, validator, fee rewards and transaction count; `transactions=true` adds the block's transaction list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-block

parameters.name: transactions
parameters.description: Also list the block's transactions (default false).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Current Solana chain information (slot, block height, epoch and its progress, transaction counts, TPS) and SOL market data (price, 24h change, market cap and rank, fees).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-chain

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
What the explorer's search finds for a keyword, grouped by kind (tokens, accounts, programs, NFT collections, domains): address, name, symbol, icon, holders, volume, FDV, verified flag and socials for tokens.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A token mint: name, symbol, icon, decimals, supply, mint and freeze authority, owner program, creator, creation and first mint time and transactions, website and socials, CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap ids, token scores, status flags, the last days of daily USD prices and the metadata account.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-token

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token mint address or a solscan.io token link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The holders of a token, largest first: rank, owner and its label, token account, amount, decimals and holder tags (whale, exchange ...), with the total number of holders. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-token-holders

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Daily USD prices of a token for a date range (the explorer's price history; default the last 30 days).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-token-price

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Transfers of a token, newest first, with the same fields and filters as account-transfers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-token-transfers

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Comma-separated: transfer, mint, burn, create_account, close_account.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The explorer's trending or newly listed tokens: mint, name, symbol, icon, price, and buy/sell volume, trade and trader counts with their change for 1h, 4h and 24h windows. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-tokens

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Solana transaction: slot, time, status, fee, signers, compute units, priority fee, error, SOL and token balance changes, instructions and inner instructions as the explorer parses them (in `raw`), with token metadata.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/solscan-transaction

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: Transaction signature or a solscan.io/tx link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
